_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. An override for the registry's in-app narrative course.title — the in-app title is narrative ('Warehouse Foundations'), this one is search-facing. Read by gen-descriptions.mjs and thumb.mjs. Deliberately does NOT lead with 'Data Warehouse', so the composed headline reads '<title> · Data Warehousing' without stammering.
